title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to Federal Register notice 2024-18761 (originally published August 21, 2024, beginning on page 67624), stating that two letters appearing on pages 67624 and 67625 should not have been included in the document.
summary: This is a correction notice from the Department of Defense (Transmittal No. 22-55) to the August 21, 2024 arms sales notice 2024-18761. It states that two letters appearing on pages 67624 and 67625 should not have been included in that document. The notice does not identify the purchasing country, equipment, values, or congressional notification date for those letters.
